The later insertion suggests a reading-order displacement; this local deletion alone does not establish omission from the complete extraction.","issue_id":"region.090f0f15a38a55e0b77e5ec6","printed_text":"7-day annualised

The later inserted extraction uses * after the value, so it does not faithfully preserve this footnote marker even if the yield text was relocated.","issue_id":"region.0dae53296b5a8bc8ca559717","printed_text":"1-day annualised
yield*: XX%#"},{"affected_condition":"30-day annualised yield display and computation-basis reference.","disposition":"LAYOUT_RELATION_UNCERTAIN","explanation":"The page visibly prints yield*: XX% beneath the 30-day heading, with no equals sign. Similar text is inserted later in the extraction; the local replacement does not establish whether the value is omitted or displaced.","issue_id":"region.5cf6fa3994708c7ce904296a","printed_text":"30-day annualised
yield*: XX%"},{"affected_condition":"Association of each yield value with its period and footnote markers.","disposition":"VISIBLE_MISSING_OR_CHANGED_TEXT","explanation":"The page has four side-by-side heading/value pairs in the transcribed order. The insertion may reflect reordered extraction, but XX%* does not match the printed 1-day value, whose trailing marker is a superscript #.","issue_id":"region.112f979983285103e5d38bca","printed_text":"7-day annualised yield*: XX%
1-day annualised yield*: XX%#
30-day annualised yield*: XX%
Most recent 1-year yield*: XX%"},{"affected_condition":null,"disposition":"VISIBLE_TYPOGRAPHIC_DIFFERENCE","explanation":"The 7-day computation paragraph begins with a round bullet, not the letter e. This is a list-marker recognition difference.","issue_id":"region.0a48344724ff0733537cbaa2","printed_text":"• 7-day annualised yield is calculated by annualising the net income, excluding capital gain/loss, for the period from xx Aug 2023 to xx Aug 2023"},{"affected_condition":null,"disposition":"VISIBLE_TYPOGRAPHIC_DIFFERENCE","explanation":"The 1-day computation paragraph begins with a round bullet, not the letter e.","issue_id":"region.c9fed8689c895907132da959","printed_text":"• 1-day annualised yield is calculated by annualising the net income, excluding capital gain/loss, for the period from xx Aug 2023 to xx Aug 2023"},{"affected_condition":null,"disposition":"VISIBLE_TYPOGRAPHIC_DIFFERENCE","explanation":"The page prints excluding as one word. Splitting it into exclud and ing is a tokenisation difference; no letters or exclusion wording change.","issue_id":"region.2c07e7e2728f1122a775c0b1","printed_text":"excluding"},{"affected_condition":null,"disposition":"VISIBLE_TYPOGRAPHIC_DIFFERENCE","explanation":"The 30-day computation paragraph begins with a round bullet, not the letter e.","issue_id":"region.b347d1c3794d3f7576f0a717","printed_text":"• 30-day annualised yield is calculated by annualising the net income, excluding capital gain/loss, for the period from xx Aug 2023 to xx Sep 2023"},{"affected_condition":null,"disposition":"VISIBLE_TYPOGRAPHIC_DIFFERENCE","explanation":"The most recent 1-year computation paragraph begins with a round bullet, not the letter e.","issue_id":"region.9473cdad124f910a91b3cfb8","printed_text":"• Most recent 1-year yield is calculated by annualising the net income, excluding capital gain/loss, for the period from xx Aug 2022 to xx Aug 2023"},{"affected_condition":null,"disposition":"VISIBLE_TYPOGRAPHIC_DIFFERENCE","explanation":"The printed expression is 1-year. Separating 1 and -year into tokens does not change the number or period.","issue_id":"region.4dbc3340e35cd633ffe8f683","printed_text":"1-year"},{"affected_condition":"Footnote linking the 1-day yield to the most up-to-date daily figure.","disposition":"VISIBLE_MISSING_OR_CHANGED_TEXT","explanation":"A superscript # precedes For and matches the marker after the 1-day yield value. Replacing it with an opening quotation mark changes the footnote identifier.","issue_id":"region.12eb91cd4598ae8a4d175856","printed_text":"#For the most up-to-date daily figure, please refer to [www.xxx.com]."}],"remaining_questions":["Does the complete extraction preserve the association of the relocated yield values with their respective column headings?"]}
